correctness.rationale: ORIGINAL math contained a falsifiable asymptotic error: the claimed odd-prime density is p³(p−1)(p²+1)/(4(p+1)(p⁵−1)), whose expansion starts 1/4−1/(2p), NOT 1/4−3/(4p) as printed. A full replacement RESULT.md now gives 1/4−1/(2p)+3/(4p²)+O(p^{-3}). The central density formula is proved by the exact upper-triangular square identity, union of (x±z) ideals, v_p exponent min(r,s) except dyadic r=s adds one, scalar-square Haar weights and a convergent geometric double sum. The zero diagonal is Haar-null. Compact inverse limit of modular root sets proves convergence of distinct finite-ring image ratios. Independent residue-image enumeration at p=2,3,5,7 and symbolic rational expansion confirmed the repaired final claim; no unrestricted conclusion rests solely on finite calculations.
